current_hash_policy: Current repository publication inventory governs public byte hashes. Dated source manifests remain historical provenance where their source records were not unambiguously mapped to edited public files. No excluded archive is declared recovered.
unresolved_reference_policy: provenance://unavailable/content-sha256 identifies original content; provenance://unavailable/path-sha256 identifies only an original historical path string. Neither is a filesystem path or a claim that content is published.
